reason: This PR looks cross-cutting and semantically risky: it changes validation of stale read and flashback timestamps across `executor`, `planner/core`, `sessionctx`, and `sessiontxn/staleread`, including `SET` handling, preprocess/plan building, and plan-cache-related code. That directly touches session/transaction behavior and SQL execution semantics, with potential high-blast-radius correctness regressions if timestamp rules become too strict, too lax, or inconsistent across parsing/planning/execution.
